machine: Intel i9-12900T / 64 GB / AMD RX6800 16 GB; macOS 15.3.1; 4K 60Hz display
method: 39 top-level MOV/MP4 clips in tests/test_videos, sequential runs on the same machine; no competing benchmark processes.
Studio: actual NativePlayerHost + production players. Reference: production ToposVideoPlayerView/MPVGLView/ToposMetalVideoView, instrumented copies only; no source repository modifications.
Baseline: 1920x1080 device-pixel canvas; 1s warmup, about 3s measured per clip. Supplement: 3600x1900, Studio about 6s and reference about 3s measured. Short samples, not full-clip endurance tests.
No main application workspace was loaded; these measurements isolate the actual preview/player views. Other application workloads may add contention.
Real GL swaps / renderer submissions are presentation proxies, not physical monitor scanout. Qt branch counts delivered video frames.

Reference Metal initialization was tested to match PlayerWindowController; shader fails on missing Uniforms members. Earlier non-Metal calibration rows were superseded with explicitly attempted production initialization.
Initial Studio diagnostic cleanup/callback faults were corrected in probe.py; subsequent focused runs exited normally. Exit-time harness errors are not attributed to playback stutter.
